blurb: Bridgeport Harbor Marina is a new 200+ slip marina and entertainment destination located on Steelpointe Peninsula. Guests can dock their boats and enjoy nearby dining, entertainment, and cultural venues. The marina offers seasonal, monthly, weekly, and overnight dockage with modern facilities and full-service boatyard.
extraNote: Dockage fee is $2.00 per foot for 4 hours, credit cards only · Reservations not needed for dock and dine, but recommended for dining · Dock "A" (towards the I-95 overpass) for dockage and docking assistance
